families.title: Family A — positive pyramiding (add to winners)

sizing_progression.notes: per-level multipliers [1.0, 0.75, 0.5] of the initial leg; aggregate = 2.25 initial legs

emergency_exit.rule: Flatten the whole basket when (a) open adverse excursion reaches 0.5% of account equity OR (b) open profit giveback reaches 50% of peak open basket profit, whichever occurs first. Stops only ever tighten, never widen.

stress_sequence.scenario: s08_combined_worst at max_levels with basket fully built

contract.notes: Carried for programme uniformity although positive pyramiding is NOT tail-amplifying under STRATEGY_ELIGIBILITY_V2 section 9 and needs no contract at intake.

mechanics.entry_trigger: Initial breakout/continuation entry per the base card (H-CW-style session window is the FTMO reference envelope).
mechanics.add_trigger: Add level 2 only when open profit >= 1.0 x ATR(14) in favour and price makes a new favourable extreme; add level 3 only when open profit >= 2.0 x ATR(14) and a second new extreme prints. One add per bar maximum.
mechanics.exposure_cap: Aggregate basket <= 2.25 initial legs AND <= 5% margin AND initial leg <= 0.25% equity risk at reference stop.
mechanics.basket_stop: Hard bound 0.5% equity adverse; plus giveback stop at 50% of peak open profit.
mechanics.trailing_logic: After level 2 fills, basket stop trails to aggregate breakeven plus costs; thereafter trails at 1.0 x ATR(14) behind the peak favourable close. Never widens.
mechanics.time_bounds: Session-flat variant: mandatory flat by the card flatten hour; no overnight carry (FTMO envelope). DXZ variant may hold with the trailing stop but never through a scheduled high-impact event.

families.expected_mechanism: Convex capture of strong intraday trends: exposure concentrates only where the tape has already confirmed direction, so the expectancy comes from letting confirmed winners run while the giveback stop monetizes the fat right tail.
families.regime_of_failure: Trend-exhaustion regimes: parabolic reversal immediately after level 3 prints converts the largest aggregate position at the worst prices; clustered same-session entries across correlated symbols (NDX/GDAXI/SP500) concentrate the giveback. Choppy range sessions produce repeated small giveback stops (death by sequence, not by single loss).

portfolio_role.ftmo: PRIMARY candidate venue: session-flat envelope removes the gap tail that a built-out basket fears most; giveback stop + daily -1% circuit breaker (H-CW convention) stack inside the 4% effective daily-loss budget.
portfolio_role.dxz: Valid as a low-margin convex sleeve; subordinate role because the passive book already carries trend capture.

invalidation_criteria: Sealed OOS + Q06 HARSH-class evidence: expectancy after costs < +0.10R per basket or net profit factor < 1.20 (H-CW kill-criteria class).
Simulated worst-day p95 of the built-out basket > 2.5% of equity at the reference 0.25% initial risk, or Monte-Carlo P(hit 4% effective daily-loss budget within 60 days) > 2%.
Giveback stop realized more often than profit target across the sealed window with no regime explanation (mechanism captures noise, not trends).
Joint-tail protocol shows the family's worst days systematically coincide with the passive book's worst days (hidden common mode, family is the tail carrier).

families.title: Family B — negative pyramiding (add to losers, hard-bounded)

sizing_progression.notes: per-level multipliers [1.0, 0.75, 0.5] — averaging in SMALLER increments; aggregate = 2.25 initial legs. Deliberately anti-martingale in size so the worst price carries the smallest weight.

emergency_exit.rule: Flatten all basket legs at a hard 1.0% of account equity open-loss bound. No 'price must return' assumption survives this bound; when it triggers, the basket is dead and re-entry requires a fresh signal next session.

stress_sequence.scenario: adverse trend through all 3 levels then continuation (s02_gap_x2 overlaid)

contract.notes: Distinct mechanism from positive pyramiding (directive section 21); NEVER collapsed into a generic pyramiding label.

mechanics.entry_trigger: Initial mean-reversion entry at a defined stretch (e.g. close beyond k x ATR from session VWAP) per the base card.
mechanics.add_trigger: Level 2 at +1.0 x ATR(14) adverse from level 1; level 3 at +2.0 x ATR(14) adverse. Adds require the original mean-reversion hypothesis still intact (no news shock bar printed); a shock bar suspends adds (fail-closed news filter).
mechanics.exposure_cap: Aggregate <= 2.25 initial legs AND <= 10% margin AND hard 1.0% equity basket-loss bound.
mechanics.basket_stop: Hard bound 1.0% equity realized via emergency_exit; individual legs carry no separate widening stops.
mechanics.trailing_logic: On recovery, basket take-profit = blended average entry + 0.5 x ATR(14); breakeven move of the basket stop once basket P&L >= +0.5% equity. Never widens.
mechanics.time_bounds: Session-flat strongly preferred; DXS/DXZ variant may carry overnight ONLY with the trailing basket stop inside the 1.0% bound and no high-impact event within the holding window.

families.expected_mechanism: Mean-reversion capture with an improved blended average price: in range regimes, adverse excursions are usually transitory, so a bounded ladder monetizes reversion while the hard 1.0% bound caps the regime-change loss.
families.regime_of_failure: Sustained directional trend (regime change): every add improves the average price but increases exposure exactly when reversion probability collapses; the terminal loss is realized at the 1.0% bound. Margin escalation at level 3 forces the flatten into the worst liquidity. A gap through the bound realizes MORE than 1.0% (slippage tail) — that overrun IS the family kill test.

portfolio_role.ftmo: RESEARCH-ONLY initially: one 1.0% basket stop plus the passive book's same-day P&L can approach the 4% effective daily-loss budget; only a session-flat variant with the daily -1% breaker is admissible for FTMO evaluation.
portfolio_role.dxz: PRIMARY research venue: no daily-loss venue rule at DXZ scale, but the 11% stop-risk budget means at most ~2 sleeves of this family at full bound.

invalidation_criteria: Stress realization: ANY sealed scenario where the realized basket loss exceeds max_basket_loss_pct by more than the preregistered slippage allowance (+0.25% equity) — the bound is not trustworthy and the family is dead for that venue until re-specified.
Mechanism death rate: terminal bound hit in > 5% of baskets over the sealed window (reversion is not there; the ladder is a slow bleed into regime change).
Economics: expectancy after Q06 HARSH-class spread/slippage degradation < 0 (costs eat the reversion edge).
Joint-tail protocol: lower-tail dependence with the passive book's trend sleeves is materially positive (they lose together exactly in trend-break regimes).

families.title: Family C — bounded martingale (finite levels, hard equity stop)

sizing_progression.notes: level lots 1x / 2x / 4x / 8x the base unit; aggregate = 15 base units. Finite — level 4 is the LAST level; there is no level 5 by construction.

emergency_exit.rule: TERMINAL FAILURE CONDITION: when level 4 is filled and price trades adverse to the level-4 stop, flatten ALL legs immediately and realize the bounded loss <= 2.0% of account equity. Same-session circuit breaker: after a terminal flatten, no re-entry until the next trading session. The sequence is finite; 'eventually price must return' is NOT an argument anywhere in this contract.

stress_sequence.scenario: s08_combined_worst at level 4 (gap x2 + spread x3 + slippage + margin spike) — the preregistered terminal failure

contract.notes: margin cap 15% and loss cap 2.0% are HARD; a gap that jumps the level-4 stop realizes the slippage overrun beyond 2.0% — the exact quantity the stress matrix measures.

mechanics.entry_trigger: Base-unit entry on the card's signal (bounded oscillation regimes only; a trend/regime filter must gate entries — a raw martingale without a regime gate is out of programme scope).
mechanics.add_trigger: Level k+1 at -1.0 x ATR(14) adverse from level k, k = 1..3. Adds suspended inside the fail-closed news blackout and after a shock bar.
mechanics.exposure_cap: Aggregate <= 15 base units AND <= 15% margin AND hard 2.0% equity terminal bound. Base unit sized so the TERMINAL realized loss (including the preregistered slippage allowance) stays <= 2.0% under s08.
mechanics.basket_stop: Basket take-profit at blended average entry + 0.25 x ATR(14) (recovery exit); terminal failure as declared in emergency_exit.
mechanics.trailing_logic: None in the classic sense; the recovery TP tightens toward blended average as levels fill. Never widens.
mechanics.time_bounds: DXZ research venue only. No FTMO variant at programme stage: a 2% terminal event plus passive-book same-day P&L can breach the 4% effective daily-loss budget (see portfolio_role).

families.expected_mechanism: In bounded-oscillation regimes, geometric doubling recovers the whole ladder on a modest reversion; the design bets that regime-filtered entries make full-ladder terminal events rare while their cost is pre-bounded at 2.0% of equity.
families.regime_of_failure: The terminal failure condition itself: a unilateral move of > 4 x ATR(14) against the basket without reversion fills all levels and realizes the 2.0% bound — and a GAP through the level-4 stop realizes MORE than 2.0% (slippage overrun). Trend regimes and news shocks are the two systemic carriers; correlation of terminal events across sleeves is the portfolio-level ruin mode the joint-tail protocol exists to detect.

portfolio_role.ftmo: EXCLUDED at programme stage: FTMO's daily-loss rule makes a 2% terminal event plus any same-day passive P&L a challenge-killer; a future session-flat FTMO variant with a smaller bound is conceivable but NOT part of this programme.
portfolio_role.dxz: SOLE research venue. At most ONE martingale sleeve at full 2.0% bound inside the 11% stop-risk budget; two would consume 4% of budget on a mechanism whose terminal events correlate.

invalidation_criteria: Terminal condition realized in > 2% of baskets on sealed data (the regime filter is not rare-fying full-ladder events; the ladder is a scheduled 2% loss machine).
ANY sealed stress scenario realizing a loss beyond 2.0% + 0.5% slippage allowance — the declared bound is proven non-binding and the family is DEAD (unbounded recovery class risk).
Margin cap breached before level 4 completes on any sealed path (the ladder cannot even finish its finite sequence).

Joint-tail protocol: terminal events coincide across aggressive sleeves beyond the independence baseline (hidden common ruin mode — family banned from multi-sleeve books regardless of standalone numbers).

families.title: Family D — bounded grid / recovery (ATR-spaced, finite, equity-bounded)

sizing_progression.notes: equal unit per grid level; aggregate = 5 base units. Grid spacing = 1.0 x ATR(14) between levels.

emergency_exit.rule: EQUITY BOUNDARY: flatten the entire grid at 1.5% of account equity open loss. BASKET EXIT (recovery): when blended basket P&L reaches blended average entry + 0.25 x ATR(14), close all legs. TIME STOP: flatten after 5 sessions regardless of P&L. Whichever triggers first. No weekend carry in the session-flat variant.

stress_sequence.scenario: unilateral trend through all 5 grid levels then gap x2 (s02) overlaid

contract.notes: Grid is symmetric around the initial entry (recovery grid), NOT a trend-following grid; trend-following grids are a different mechanism and are out of this family.

mechanics.entry_trigger: Initial entry per the base card in a defined mean-reverting range regime; grid levels pre-computed at +/- 1.0 x ATR(14) spacing.
mechanics.add_trigger: Passive limit-style fills at each grid level as price traverses adverse; adds suspended during news blackout / after a shock bar (fail-closed).
mechanics.exposure_cap: Aggregate <= 5 base units AND <= 12% margin AND hard 1.5% equity boundary AND 5-session time stop.
mechanics.basket_stop: Blended recovery TP (avg entry + 0.25 x ATR) OR 1.5% equity boundary OR 5-session time stop — first hit wins.
mechanics.trailing_logic: Recovery TP ratchets down toward blended average as deeper levels fill; the equity boundary never moves. Never widens.
mechanics.time_bounds: Session-flat variant mandatory for any FTMO evaluation (flat by flatten hour, no weekend carry); DXZ variant bounded by the 5-session time stop.

families.expected_mechanism: In oscillating regimes the grid harvests the range around the blended average and the recovery exit monetizes reversion to mean; equal sizing keeps the tail linear (not geometric) so the equity boundary is reachable and meaningful.
families.regime_of_failure: Unilateral trend traversal of all 5 levels: the grid holds maximal exposure at maximal adverse prices and the 1.5% boundary realizes; a gap through the boundary realizes the overrun. Same-symbol grids across sleeves stack into one deep synthetic basket — the joint-tail protocol's common-symbol exposure metric is the designed detector.

portfolio_role.ftmo: CONDITIONAL: only the session-flat variant (no gap/weekend tail, daily breaker stacks with the 1.5% boundary inside the 4% effective budget) is admissible for FTMO evaluation.
portfolio_role.dxz: PRIMARY research venue alongside family B; at most 2 grid sleeves per symbol class inside the 11% stop-risk budget with cross-sleeve grid-depth limits from the joint-tail engine.

invalidation_criteria: Equity boundary realized in > 4% of baskets on sealed data, or realized boundary loss exceeds 1.5% + 0.4% slippage allowance in ANY sealed scenario (bound not binding -> family dead).
Recovery exit unreachable: median time-in-basket at max depth exceeds the 5-session time stop on the sealed window (the grid becomes a forced-loss inventory).
Economics: expectancy after Q06 HARSH-class costs < 0, or swap/rollover cost > 10% of gross P&L in any carried variant (H-CW convention).
Joint-tail protocol: same-symbol grid depth across sleeves breaches the common-symbol exposure budget under the joint-escalation scenario.

stress_matrix._note: Deterministic preregistered stress definitions. Base quantities are measured from the SEALED streams per symbol class (never live data): base_gap = empirical 99.5th percentile adverse gap for the symbol class on sealed history; base_spread = 20-day median spread at entry time (H-CW spread_median_mult convention); ATR = ATR(14) on the sealed series. Every scenario is applied at max_levels depth with the basket fully built. Pass criteria reference the family's own contract bounds — a scenario result is EVIDENCE, not a verdict.

base_quantities.base_gap: empirical 99.5th percentile adverse gap, sealed history, per symbol class
base_quantities.base_spread: 20-day median spread at entry time, sealed history
base_quantities.slippage_model: every forced exit fills at stop - max(1 x spread, 0.1 x ATR(14))
base_quantities.news_shock_bar: first bar range after event > 2.5 x ATR(14) (shock_atr_mult upper bound, H-CW convention)

scenarios.description: Sealed-history base gap applied against a fully built basket at max_levels; measures the raw gap tail with no multiplier.
Adverse gap of 2 x base_gap through the deepest level's stop; the core gap-overrun measurement for every averaging family.
pass_criteria: no residual open risk after flatten

scenarios.description: Extreme adverse gap 3 x base_gap; the bound-stress case. Realized loss beyond bound + allowance here is a family-level INVALIDATION trigger, not a tuning input.
pass_criteria: basket_realized_loss_pct recorded and reported even on breach
documented_overrun <= family_slippage_allowance or family declared invalid

scenarios.description: Spread fixed at 2 x base_spread across entry, adds and exits; measures cost degradation of the ladder mechanics (Q06 HARSH-class).
Spread 3 x base_spread plus the slippage model on every forced exit; the HARSH execution floor.

Scheduled high-impact event (FOMC/NFP/CPI) inside the holding window; adds suspended by the fail-closed news filter, existing basket marked through the news shock bar. Factory news calendar only (D:/QM/data/news_calendar); never a live source.
pass_criteria: no new levels added inside the blackout window

scenarios.description: Broker margin requirement multiplied by 1.5 with the basket at max depth; tests whether the finite sequence can even complete.

s02 + s05 + s07 simultaneously at max_levels: gap x2, spread x3 + slippage, margin spike. The preregistered worst case every family contract's stress_sequence names. A family that breaches bound + allowance here is invalid; a family that survives reports the exact realized bound consumption.
pass_criteria: no residual open risk after flatten

joint_tail_protocol.known_evidence_gap: intra-basket per-level state is not universally captured in current sealed streams; the wave-2 engine derives basket depth by open-position reconstruction from the trade stream or requires an EA-emitted basket-depth telemetry column (PORTFOLIO_TAIL_RISK_RESEARCH.md section 3). Never guessed.
joint_tail_protocol.basket_depth_reconstruction: open-position reconstruction from the sealed trade stream (entry/exit per deal); a derived basket-depth path per sleeve per bar is the input to the escalation metrics

methods.empirical_joint_tails: co-exceedance counts P(R_i <= q_a, R_j <= q_a) for sleeve daily returns at a in {0.05, 0.025, 0.01}; non-parametric, per pair and joint
methods.lower_tail_dependence_lambda_L: non-parametric tail-dependence estimator from the empirical co-exceedance function (e.g. log-periodogram/CFG-class estimator on the lower tail); a high lambda_L at low Pearson r is the common-ruin warning
methods.worst_day_overlap: for each sleeve's worst N=10 days, count cross-sleeve coincidences; compare against an independence permutation baseline (2000 seed-pinned permutations); materially worse than the 95th permutation percentile fails acceptance part 2
methods.correlation_convergence: rolling pairwise return correlation, calm-window (body, |r| below median) vs shock-window (bottom decile of an aggregate market-factor return); test H0 rho_tail <= rho_body against HA rho_tail > rho_body per pair
methods.block_bootstrap_joint_worst_sequence: circular block bootstrap of the joint daily return matrix, block = 10 days, 2000 seed-pinned replications; emits the distribution of joint worst-day and worst-sequence account losses against the venue budget
methods.drawdown_clustering: inter-drawdown-interval dispersion index vs the exponential (Poisson) independence baseline; clustering (overdispersion) fails acceptance part 2 evidence
methods.joint_basket_escalation: from reconstructed basket-depth paths: probability and depth of >= 2 sleeves at >= 60% and at 100% of their max_levels simultaneously, and the implied joint account loss vs each sleeve's max_basket_loss_pct and the 4% effective daily-loss budget
methods.common_symbol_exposure: net + gross same-symbol exposure across sleeves per bar; worst simultaneous same-symbol basket depth; common-session and common-volatility exposure buckets
methods.margin_escalation_path: joint max_margin_pct consumption path; peak simultaneous margin under s07/s08
methods.gaussian_copula_tail_comparison: BASELINE ONLY: fit a Gaussian copula (implied lambda_L = 0) and report the divergence from empirical lambda_L as a diagnostic of non-Gaussian tail dependence. EXPLICITLY NOT A SAFETY ARGUMENT — no diversification claim may rest on a copula baseline.
methods.simultaneous_recovery_escalation: conditional probability that one sleeve's terminal/recovery escalation coincides with another sleeve's escalation start within +/- 2 sessions

joint_tail_protocol.gap_scenarios_joint: apply s02/s03 jointly across sleeves sharing a symbol class or session: do baskets sit open into the same weekend/news gap; report joint realized loss vs the 4% effective daily-loss budget

acceptance_rule.source: PORTFOLIO_TAIL_RISK_RESEARCH.md section 4 (all four must hold; else EVIDENCE_MISSING/FAIL — never 'diversification proven' by normal-period correlation alone)
acceptance_rule.part_1_joint_tail_bound: simulated joint worst-day / worst-sequence account loss within the venue daily-loss budget (5% x 0.8 = 4% effective) and within the 11% total stop-risk budget, under the joint-escalation scenario
acceptance_rule.part_2_no_hidden_common_ruin_mode: lambda_L and joint basket escalation within preregistered thresholds; worst-day overlap not materially worse than independence
acceptance_rule.part_3_additive_not_illusory: joint book tail (CVaR / worst-sequence) materially better than exposure-weighted sum of sleeve tails, surviving shock windows not only calm windows
acceptance_rule.part_4_every_sleeve_bounded: each sleeve carries a valid non-UNBOUNDED_RECOVERY strategy_risk_contract.v1

proposed_thresholds.worst_day_overlap_max_vs_independence_p9: observed overlap must not exceed the 95th percentile of the independence permutation baseline
